checkpoint_position.policy: Every fitted classifier, latent model, centroid, projection, calibration model, or assay summary is a fold-local state derived from admitted training donors. No state may be carried across outer folds or updated with withheld features.

input_contract.bulk_state_transfer: Aggregate only observed RNA or protein within each participant and assay using a modality-native rule. Independent RNA and protein cohorts remain unpaired.
input_contract.rna_conditioned_atac: Training ATAC may be aggregated by donor and cell state, but observed held-donor ATAC is evaluator-only and cannot enter a prediction feature, normalization reference, target-derived peak filter, or fallback.

assay_native_pseudobulk.release_condition: Freeze a project implementation and license, assay-specific aggregation and normalization, predictive rule, fold-local artifacts, missing-state behavior, and hashes.

cca.inductive_status: unresolved; a jointly fitted train-query CCA is transductive and ineligible for a sealed champion
cca.input_contract: Single-cell or single-nucleus RNA only; exact gene universe, scaling, regularization, anchor or pairing rule, projection direction, and classifier head are unresolved.
cca.release_condition: Freeze a training-only implementation, package or source revision, license, feature and pairing contract, seed, fitted state, and query projection that never refits on held cells.

celltypist_baseline.inductive_status: The fold-trained logistic classifier is inductive only when query-dependent majority voting or clustering is disabled. Any majority-vote diagnostic is transductive and must be reported separately.
celltypist_baseline.input_contract: Fold-local custom model using the training donor RNA matrix and frozen broad labels. AnnData input is log1p normalized to 10000 counts per cell; feature axis, centering, solver, regularization, balancing, calibration, and seed remain to be frozen.
celltypist_baseline.pretrained_weight_policy: Do not download, select, ensemble, or use built-in CellTypist classifiers. Only a new classifier fit inside the outer training fold is admissible.
celltypist_baseline.release_condition: The package is permissively licensed, but an open champion additionally requires a frozen runtime, project-generated fitted-state hash, safe loading policy, input-data release review, and the sealed task gate.

harmony_logistic.inductive_status: transductive_diagnostic_only; released harmonypy 0.0.10 jointly estimates cell-specific correction and has no registered frozen-reference held-query transform
harmony_logistic.input_contract: Normalized expression or PCA plus batch metadata. Any PCA, normalization, Harmony fit, and logistic head would have to be fit without held cells.
harmony_logistic.release_condition: Not champion-eligible in the current contract. A later implementation would require a prespecified transductive diagnostic TaskSpec or a validated frozen-reference transform, plus GPL-compliant release.

hvg_pca_elastic_net.algorithm: Multinomial elastic-net logistic regression; C=1; l1_ratio=0.5; SAGA; max_iter=5000.
hvg_pca_elastic_net.release_condition: Open for the cell-state task under existing project authorities after task selection lock and sealed success. The declared bulk role requires a separate donor-level bulk implementation before use.

hvg_pca_knn.algorithm: 15-neighbor Euclidean vote in PCA space with donor/class-balanced training weights and canonical-row tie breaking.
hvg_pca_knn.release_condition: Open for the cell-state task under existing project authorities after task selection lock and sealed success.

hvg_pca_linear_svm.algorithm: Linear SVM; C=1; donor-grouped three-fold out-of-fold calibration by multinomial L2 logistic regression.
hvg_pca_linear_svm.release_condition: Open for the cell-state task under existing project authorities after task selection lock and sealed success. The declared bulk role requires a separate donor-level bulk implementation before use.

hvg_pca_logistic.algorithm: Multinomial L2 logistic regression; C=1; LBFGS; max_iter=5000.
hvg_pca_logistic.release_condition: Open for the cell-state task under existing project authorities after task selection lock and sealed success.

hvg_pca_nearest_centroid.algorithm: Donor/class-weighted class centroids; squared Euclidean distance; training-derived softmax temperature.
hvg_pca_nearest_centroid.release_condition: Open for the cell-state task under existing project authorities after task selection lock and sealed success. The declared bulk role requires a separate donor-level bulk implementation before use.

mean_expression_bulk.input_contract: Participant-level assay-native bulk RNA or bulk proteomics. The exact feature universe, cohort scaling, covariate treatment, mean predictor, program projection, and output are unresolved.
mean_expression_bulk.release_condition: Freeze a project implementation and license, participant-level input contract, training-only cohort transform and mean, covariates, missing states, seed, and fitted/output hashes.

pca_procrustes.inductive_status: unresolved; fitting an alignment with held-query geometry or anchors is transductive and ineligible for a sealed champion
pca_procrustes.input_contract: Single-cell or single-nucleus RNA only; exact gene universe, scaling, PCA, anchor correspondence, Procrustes transform, classifier, and query policy are unresolved.
pca_procrustes.release_condition: Freeze a training-only implementation, package or source revision, license, features, anchors, seed, fitted state, and query transform that never learns from held geometry.

scanvi_baseline.inductive_status: unresolved_and_blocked; official reference mapping can train a query model on held features, which is transductive domain adaptation and conflicts with the current training-partition-only contract
scanvi_baseline.input_contract: Raw UMI counts with a frozen Ensembl gene universe and broad-label ontology. Count layer, batch and biological covariates, unlabeled category, SCVI initialization, classifier architecture, query mapping, seeds, early stopping, and calibration remain to be frozen.
scanvi_baseline.release_condition: Package terms permit redistribution with notices, but a champion requires a Python 3.11+ lock, training-only query policy, fold-generated weights, dependency and input-data review, fitted-state hashes, and sealed success.

scvi_baseline.inductive_status: unresolved_and_blocked; either define a frozen encoder path with no query update or classify official query training as a separately reported transductive diagnostic
scvi_baseline.input_contract: Raw UMI counts with a frozen Ensembl gene universe. Count layer, batch and biological covariates, latent dimension, likelihood, downstream classifier head, query mapping, seeds, early stopping, and calibration remain to be frozen.
scvi_baseline.release_condition: Package terms permit redistribution with notices, but a champion requires a Python 3.11+ lock, training-only query policy, fold-generated weights, dependency and input-data review, fitted-state hashes, and sealed success.

package_identity_findings.celltypist: PyPI 1.7.1 and Git commit fe357564a6625d3b1732a022fd39f18e55696e80 agree on version 1.7.1. The exact wheel and sdist hashes are recorded; neither artifact was downloaded.
package_identity_findings.harmonypy: GitHub release v0.0.10 resolves to a770f2d and PyPI 0.0.10 publishes exact wheel and sdist hashes under GPL-3.0-or-later. A later release exists, so latest is prohibited.
package_identity_findings.scvi_tools: GitHub release 1.4.2 identifies dc95497. PyPI publishes a wheel hash matching the registry and attests the release workflow at b35cb7d3868ea110f60e0fb260d94fe054ea0470. The tag, package version, and wheel hash are separate frozen identity fields; none is inferred from another.

safe_artifact_contract.project_generated_state: Load only a bounded, schema-validated fold artifact whose source model, code, environment, training rows, feature axis, parameters, and SHA-256 are registered.
safe_artifact_contract.serialized_python_objects: Do not deserialize downloaded or untrusted pickle or torch objects. CellTypist state must be generated locally and hashed; scvi-tools state must use a pinned safe-loading policy and remain project-generated.

input_contract.label: frozen broad_liver_five_v1 class
input_contract.unit: dataset-view donor_id admitted as cohort_family_id plus person_key

preprocessing.feature_selection: Training-only rank-binned normalized dispersion with 20 mean bins, top 2000 genes, and Ensembl-ID tie breaking.
preprocessing.normalization: Per-cell library-size scaling to 10000 followed by log1p.
preprocessing.pca: Training-only centered full SVD with at most 50 components.
preprocessing.split: SHA256(split_seed NUL donor_id), first 8 bytes big-endian modulo 5.
preprocessing.training_weights: Equal class mass, then equal donor mass within class, rescaled to the training-cell count.

shared_hvg_pca_execution.scope_limit: The authority and adapter implement cell_state_mapping only. Registry declarations for bulk_state_transfer are not executable implementations.
